E3102

`{item}` is part of the low-level tier.

What

`{item}` is part of the low-level tier.

Why

Naming `Ptr`, `volatile_read`, or an allocator needs the discovery gate.

Fix

add `use core.mem;` at the top of the file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3102: tests/ui/lowlevel_from_addr_without_mem.stderr.
